titulo: Radiation-Associated Lung Adenosquamous Carcinoma Diagnosed by Robotic-Assisted Bronchoscopy With Cone-Beam CT Guidance and Treated With Robotic Superior Segmentectomy: A Case Report

fig.label: Figure 1
fig.caption: Development of new left lower lobe pulmonary lesion on surveillance CT imaging.Axial CT chest images demonstrating interval development of a spiculated left lower lobe pulmonary nodule adjacent to areas of post-radiation fibrosis and traction bronchiectasis within the previously irradiated thoracic field. Comparison imaging highlights progression from subtle parenchymal abnormality to a more discrete suspicious lesion.
